## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the §6.3 **Recompute** procedure row — verify inputs;
   reconstruct frozen grade selection; reconcile planned slots; rerun
   pinned analysis; compare counts/membership/weights/unknown
   bounds/raw and joint veto outcomes/estimates/intervals/refusals/
   full families and prices — inside `hh-analysis` (the native owner;
   I-02 one home; no new `hh recompute` command per §6.3).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.25.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results. Comparison rule verbatim: identities/native derived
   hashes, membership/order, counts/missingness and categorical
   verdicts exact; portable scalar tolerance `abs(new−reference) ≤
   1e−10 × max(1,abs(reference))` at full precision before formatting;
   same pinned implementation/seed is reference; nonfinite values or a
   changed threshold/verdict fail even inside tolerance; tolerance
   frozen before execution — never widened, never a recipe-side fork.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.21
   `evidence-package/1`, R5.22 `closure_walk`/`closure_report`, R5.23
   `assemble_receipt`/`DeclaredReceipt`/`AnalysisDecl`
   (`population-receipt/1`), the landed `analyze`/`analyze_and_record`
   report shapes, R5.24 decode bounds + R0 fold. A new
   shared/persisted decision lands in the owning ADR admission
   (landing-record ADR, ADR-0024 rung).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): verify first, rebuild historical
  selection/population and native analysis; exact
  identity/order/count/verdict and portable scalar tolerance both hold
  on informative fixture; full precision and frozen seeds/draws
  preserved.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): wrong selector/price/weight/family/draw,
  withheld input, unsupported estimator or nonfinite value refuses; a
  threshold/verdict change fails even inside tolerance; no wider
  tolerance or recipe-side formula fork.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership and evidence): the contributing primary
  targets resolved to numbered checks + actual evidence in the
  coverage register; achieved D/E recorded separately from owed R/P
  (contributing-only stamps; full-target predicates stay owed).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression; fmt +
  owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode per touch; scratch
  stores; exact commands + counts.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in scope; REQ ids
  stamped; DEFERRALS rows for owed legs; ADRs for owned decisions;
  run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; operating clauses.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-analysis/src/recompute.rs` (new, ≈330 lines) — the §6.3
   Recompute owner interface, records-in/records-out like
   `assemble_receipt`:
   `recompute_analysis(plan: &RecomputePlan, input: &AnalysisInput)
   -> Result<RecomputeReport, AnalysisError>`.
   - `RecomputePlan{spec, declared: &AnalysisDecl, reference:
     Option<&Json>, population: Option<PopulationPins>}`;
     `PopulationPins{view, metric_ref, declared: &DeclaredReceipt}` —
     the receipt's `analysis` member must equal `plan.declared`.
   - **Leg `verify_inputs`** (before any computation): `reference`
     withheld/malformed → `RecomputeError::Withheld`/`MalformedReference`
     (`schema: "analysis_report_body/1"` + `generated_from` +
     `report_id` + `kind` required); declared `prices`/`method`/
     `weights`/`spec_ref` absent → `Withheld{member}`; pin equality
     `decl.spec_ref == spec.spec_id()`, `decl.prices.
     price_table_version == input.price_table_version` (optional
     `confidence_ppm` member non-int → `NonFinite`, ≠ → `WrongPin`),
     `decl.seed == input.seed`, `decl.draws == input.
     resampling_draws`, `decl.method` deep-equal the reference's frozen
     `kind-section.metadata` (`method.<path>` drift → `WrongPin` —
     estimator/version/prior/keys.population covers "wrong
     family"), `decl.weights` equal the section's `weights`/
     `weights_ref` member, `decl.report_ref` == `report_id`,
     `reference.kind == spec.kind`; rebuilt `generated_from_for(input)`
     member-wise vs `reference.generated_from`; `report_id_for` identity.
     Every member mismatch is a typed `WrongPin{member,declared,
     derived}` — never a rerun under altered pins.
   - **Leg `population`**: when supplied, `assemble_receipt(view,
     project_runs(input).0, input.tasks, metric_ref,
     input.watermark_set.runs, declared)` — `Err` propagates, a
     non-`closed` verdict → `RecomputeError::SelectionNotClosed`
     (frozen grade selection + planned-slot reconcile is the
     verify-first predicate, not a drift).
   - **Leg `rerun`**: `analyze(spec, input)` — kernel refusals
     verbatim (`UnknownMethod`/`UnsupportedPrior`/`NonFiniteInput`… —
     one refusal vocabulary, CC1).
   - **Leg `compare`**: recursive body walk — `identity` (member
     presence/type/key-set), `count` (array/arity), `order` (array
     membership-equal but reordered), `verdict` (Str/Bool/Null),
     `threshold` (Int in the closed exact set — pins/counts/levels/
     draws/seed), `scalar` (Int estimate beyond tolerance). Verdict
     `reproduced` iff every leg passed and drifts is empty.
   - `RecomputeError` → `AnalysisError::Recompute` (one boundary
     vocabulary; `xerr` renders verbatim).
2. `crates/hh-analysis/src/error.rs` — `Recompute(RecomputeError)`
   variant + `From` (+≈35); `crates/hh-analysis/src/lib.rs` — module +
   exports (+≈8).
3. `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_25.rs` (≈380 lines) — EX-02 fixture
   (the r5_16 shape: 2 tasks × 2 arms × 5 reps, `beta{1,1}` only per
   DF-R5.17-1) + the r5_23-shape `DeclaredReceipt` covering it; the
   reference body produced by `analyze`/`analyze_and_record` itself.
4. Build-memory records: this ledger, landing ADR-0403 +
   index/revisit-trigger regeneration (BL-47 home), dated coverage
   note, `docs/build/pr/R5.25.md`, closeout (BUILD_INDEX seq-195 row,
   LEDGER advance, ci-boundary record).
